deliberately_excluded.why: GCG1-AC5's bound: a grant wide enough to answer everything destroys the refusal evidence OG-v-7 exists to grade. Each excluded column is a real name in the contract's field catalog, so a request for one is refused as OUT OF SCOPE rather than as an unknown field -- which is what makes it a discriminator.
